video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.07.2026

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell's leadership during training camp
quotes.excerpt: He leads with actions first of all. He doesn't miss practice, he never misses a drill.
quotes.quote: He leads with actions first of all. He doesn't miss practice, he never misses a drill. He goes full out in every drill. That's and then you add the ability to teach, especially with the younger guys and communicate with the older guys, stopping drills. I know offensively we had him and Don and Evan teach certain sets and they were great at it. So we get to use his IQ and we tried to do that in camp.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says Donovan Mitchell leads by example in camp. He never misses a drill and is actively teaching younger players. Atkinson noted they are using his high basketball IQ to help install sets.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the team's goal to be a top-five defense
quotes.excerpt: The goal is always be top 10 in offense and defense that gives you a real chance.
quotes.quote: The goal is always be top 10 in offense and defense that gives you a real chance in the playoffs. It's a good sign, but ultimately the ultimate goal is to be a really strong playoff defensive team. That to me, that's where this team is and you have to build to that. But again, I've always been top 10 on both sides.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the goal for the Cavaliers is to be a top 10 team on both ends of the floor. He emphasized that building a strong defensive identity is the ultimate priority for a deep playoff run.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Omar Cook's value to the coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: He's just like as a player, he's got a great feel. Certain coaches have a feel for the game.
quotes.quote: He helps me a lot because he's just like as a player, he's got a great feel. Certain coaches have a feel for the game and an elevated feel for the game. He's one of them. We really rely on him a lot. Obviously from the development standpoint, it's important. He's got the point guard mentality. He's a really valuable member of our staff.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson praised assistant coach Omar Cook for his elevated feel for the game. Atkinson noted that Cook is a vital part of the staff who brings a point guard mentality to player development.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the process of deciding on starting lineups
quotes.excerpt: A lot of discussion who works best with who, feeling that, collaborating with the players.
quotes.quote: A lot of discussion who works best with who, feeling that, collaborating with the players on what they like. And then you also have to consider minute stints where each guy is, so you have to match that. Does Evan function better in longer stints? Does J.A. function better in longer stints? Because that does how you combo, how you combine them, that plays a role in it too.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the team is still collaborating on starting lineups. He is looking at how players like Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen function in different minute stints to determine the best combinations.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the team's backup point guard rotation
quotes.excerpt: When Donovan and Evan, they're kind of the backup point guards for each other.
quotes.quote: When Donovan and Evan, they're kind of the backup point guards for each other. That person doesn't necessarily have to be a point guard. It's got to be a ball handler, your secondary ball handler. But usually Donovan or or or or Evan will be handling it most of the time and then you got Evan as your kind of third ball handler.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs are looking at Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley to serve as the primary ball handlers. He noted that the backup point guard role does not necessarily need to be a traditional point guard.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the longevity of stars like LeBron, Steph, and KD
quotes.excerpt: I don't see any slippage. There's a shift in the NBA, shifting professional sports.
quotes.quote: I don't see any slippage. There's a shift in the NBA, shifting professional sports where you see the tennis guys like Jokic. All these guys are playing longer and it's a testament to all their support system around them, all the modalities, recovery tools. We travel better. It's just an accumulation of things that help these guys and obviously the elite ones take care of their body really well.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says he sees no slippage from NBA stars like LeBron James, Steph Curry, and Kevin Durant. He credits better recovery tools, travel, and support systems for the increased longevity of elite players.
